key_reasoning.reason: Four components changed across two subsystems: BatchJobRunner (channel lifecycle, widened Job budget, bridge-path filtering), CodeExecutorTool and SandboxSessionManager (pooled bridge wiring removed), WorkspaceScriptRunner (tool-call limit resolution, exchange dir), plus a customer-config declaration. The existing ToolCallChannel is reused, so there is no new abstraction.

Closest precedent is the removed pooled-mode bridge wiring, which does not cover the Job pod lifecycle: the channel must start at pod Running and stop before downloads, and the Job needs one shared wall-clock budget. Sandbox-security handling is new: bridge folder paths are excluded from exports and changed-file pulls (normalised path check) and the tool-calling timeout is clamped. Concurrency and Kubernetes exec behaviour bring real regression risk, and the ticket needed a follow-up pass on review findings.

11 files changed (6 source, 5 test, including a README) across src/codemie, src/codemie_tools and tests. That maps to XL by file count. The net diff is roughly balanced (583 insertions, 642 deletions) because much of it is removal.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk held at L: sandbox export-path filtering for the bridge folder and a clamped tool-calling timeout are security-relevant with no exact precedent in the removed pooled-mode code
